tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground. Default background for every screen, document and print piece.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, passage blocks, menus and inputs that sit on `paper`.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Quiet wells and table stripes beneath `paper`; also the hover ground for secondary buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `paper`, `paper-raised`, `paper-sunk`, `sage` and `blush`. A deep teal-black, never pure black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and metadata on `paper`, `paper-raised` and `paper-sunk`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card borders on `paper`. Not for control borders (too faint): use `line-strong`.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and any outline that must be seen (3:1 on `paper` and `paper-raised`).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Fill of the primary button and active states. Deep teal in light, lamp gold in dark. Text on it is `on-action`.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for `action`.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `action`.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and text buttons on `paper` and `paper-raised`. Always underlined.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 3px solid with 3px offset on every interactive element. Teal in light, gold in dark; 3:1 or better on all three paper grounds.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: The brand colour. Large fields, the left page of the mark, headings on dark-teal templates. Text on it is `on-teal`.

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text on `teal` fields.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The lamp. Use only as a fill or a mark: the dot in the logo, a highlight, the primary button in dark. Never as text or a thin line on light grounds (1.8:1 on `paper`). Text on it is `on-gold`.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text on `gold` fills.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: The warm second voice: the right page of the mark, the Kids chip, calls to gather. Text on it is `on-ember`.

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Text on `ember` fills.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Soft green tint for Read resources and gentle panels such as the prompt box. Text on it is `on-sage`.

tokens.name: on-sage
tokens.usage: Text on `sage` panels.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Soft warm tint for Watch resources and quotes. Text on it is `on-blush`.

tokens.name: on-blush
tokens.usage: Text on `blush` panels.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Small warm accent text (verse numbers, references, labels) on `paper` and `paper-raised`. Use instead of `ember` for text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed state text and icon on `paper`. Always paired with a word or icon, never colour alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution text and icon on `paper`. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icon on `paper`. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: teal-deep
tokens.usage: The brand teal in every theme. Ground of video, podcast and social templates and of the app icon. Text on it is `on-teal`; marks on it are `on-teal`, `ember-light` and `gold`.

tokens.name: ember-light
tokens.usage: Ember for dark grounds: the right page of the mark on `teal-deep` and on dark `paper`. Fill only, never text (3.7:1 on `teal-deep`, 6.1:1 on dark `paper`).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Darkening layer over photographs and video frames so `on-teal` text stays readable (about 70% teal-black).

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Hero titles, video thumbnails, podcast cover. Mobile: 44px/46px.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Project titles and section openers. Mobile: 38px/42px.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings in guides and articles. Mobile: 28px/34px.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: Where two or three are gathered
styles.usage: Pull quotes and social quote cards.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Small headings, list titles, nav items.

styles.name: ui-body
styles.sample: Pick a project and read it together.
styles.usage: Interface copy, form text, short descriptions.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase overlines, chips and prompt labels. Always uppercase.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: A guide for friends who want to know God, and each other, better.
styles.usage: Opening paragraph under a title. Mobile: 19px/30px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We read slowly, out loud, and we stop to ask what each of us noticed.
styles.usage: Long-form text in guides, articles and notes. Keep to 66 characters a line.

styles.name: verse
styles.usage: Scripture passages. Verse numbers use `label` size in `accent-text`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight gaps between related items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside buttons, chips and small stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap and card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop, gap between blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of a page on mobile.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between sections of a page on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Hero padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Top and bottom of full-width bands.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tags, focus rings.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Menus, passage blocks, prompt boxes.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and image frames.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero panels and template colour blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and chips. In SVG set rx to half the short side instead.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards on `paper`. Dark theme relies on `line` borders; keep the same value.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus and dialogs only.

tokens.name: measure-reading
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for `body`, `verse` and `lede`.

tokens.name: container-page
tokens.usage: Maximum width of page content on desktop.

tokens.name: gutter-mobile
tokens.usage: Side padding of pages under 640px.
